newsitem.title: UK: P&O firm after Laing repeats "buy" rating.
newsitem.headline: P&O firm after Laing repeats "buy" rating.

text.p: Shares in P&O Plc held firm against a falling UK stock market on Wednesday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing repeated a "buy" rating on the stock following a meeting with the company last week, dealers said.
The stock was up 1/2p at 633 by 1146 GMT, after earlier rising as much as 6-1/2p, even as the FTSE 100 index dropped some 0.7 percent.

Dealers said Laing analysts said they expected 1997 to be another year of rationalisation at P&O, which has already taken restructuring steps such as the merger of its containers operations with those of Nedlloyd.

Laing also pointed out that P&O was trading on an 18 percent discount to the rest of the market in terms of its prospective price-earnings ratio for 1998, and that it should also be supported by its above-average yield of six percent.
Analysts at Laing were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this month P&O shares dropped after UBS cut the stock to "hold" from "buy" after a strong run and lowered its 1997 pre-tax profit estimate by ten percent.
